intro: This page shows the eight documents of the worked example. They were written for the workshop from World Development Indicators values retrieved on 13 October 2026, and none of them is an official publication. The application built in notebooks 02 to 07 searches only this collection.

Notebook 02 splits each document at its headings into chunks. When the application uses a chunk in an answer, it cites the chunk as `[document id · section · year]`. Each chunk on this page is labelled with that citation.
sources: The figures in the briefs are rounded from [`indicators.csv`](../indicators.csv), and the 2016 summary reproduces the 2015 values.
